newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower. [CORRECTED 23:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower. [CORRECTED 23:32 GMT]

text.p: July 23 - IMM currency futures ended quiet afternoon trade mostly lower. Crosses dominated as one firm was seen unwinding size short mark/long yen and also sold sterling. Mark futures firmed (corrects direction) when Fed vice chair Rivlin told House committee the dollar may not get much stronger. Some tied pound whippiness to uncertainty about potential for more UK tightening.
